annotations.title: Read a site's content rights and AI policy

description: Returns, signed, what a site declares AI may do with a page: train, ground, summarize, cite or transact. Each answer is merged from robots.txt, Content-Signal, ai.txt, TDM-Rep, robots meta, X-Robots-Tag and the terms page, with the deciding signal and any conflicts. Use for permission questions; not legal advice. For whether crawlers can actually reach the site use crawler_path.

agent.description: One crawler product token (e.g. GPTBot) to answer for that agent alone
